open_points.subject: operation_element_conclusion
open_points.text: then an approval of the element with status requested makes it wait with reason owner_approval and that approval_id — after an attempt resolved not_applied only one that counts for its resend (find_send_authority), whose attempt_number is greater than that attempt's;
open_points.other_text: otherwise MUST return ApprovalAuthority for the oldest in store order of the element's approvals that count — for a resend after not_applied only those its behaviour note admits — read with ApprovalsOfElement, whose status is approved and whose request_digest equals the given request_digest;
open_points.question: Must a post-not_applied requested approval count for the waiting conclusion, or does “counts” retain find_send_authority's requirement that the approval already be approved and have the matching request_digest?

open_points.subject: reach_operation_element
open_points.text: When find_send_authority returns None MUST, unless an approval of the element with status requested already exists — for a resend after not_applied only one that counts for it (find_send_authority), so a fresh approval is always requested after not_applied —, write one RequestApprovalChange for the element with the binding_id, input_digests, the prepared request_digest and an ApprovalPreview of the operation's service_id, operation_name and effect_class, the prepared request description and the element's input PortRefs;
open_points.other_text: otherwise MUST return ApprovalAuthority for the oldest in store order of the element's approvals that count — for a resend after not_applied only those its behaviour note admits — read with ApprovalsOfElement, whose status is approved and whose request_digest equals the given request_digest;
open_points.question: How can a requested approval satisfy the instruction that it count according to find_send_authority when find_send_authority counts only approved approvals with the given request_digest?

open_points.subject: reach_operation_element
open_points.text: for a resend after not_applied only one that counts for it (find_send_authority), so a fresh approval is always requested after not_applied
open_points.other_text: Nothing is sent and the element waits with reason owner_approval for that approval, the existing requested one when there was one, even if its request_digest differs.
open_points.question: After not_applied, must a requested approval with a different request_digest be ignored and replaced because it does not count under find_send_authority, or must the element wait on that existing requested approval despite the differing digest?
